engineMappingsNotOfficialFaq.mapping: For each exact native finalized-target event, after its real card cost is paid and before observer target mutations, freeze the living participants, unique largest Hand actor, unique highest HP target, and original primary target count. A target added by another skill earlier in that same window does not revoke an already-issued originally-single opportunity. Current selection still rechecks native target legality.

engineMappingsNotOfficialFaq.topic: Ordinary trick scope and BorrowedSword target structure
engineMappingsNotOfficialFaq.status: Confirmed root implementation mapping; no dedicated official FAQ located
engineMappingsNotOfficialFaq.mapping: Use the native InstantTrick domain, excluding delayed tricks. BorrowedSword counts weapon owners as primary targets, not their paired victims. Adding a primary target keeps a genuine legal weapon-owner/victim pair. A Congjian owner joining as weapon owner must currently own a weapon and have a legal victim; selecting oneself does not bypass those native requirements.

engineMappingsNotOfficialFaq.status: Confirmed root implementation mapping; no dedicated official FAQ located
engineMappingsNotOfficialFaq.mapping: The accepted joining source and promised reward belong to the exact owning native CardUse. The completed-use branch rewards once only if positive damage from that same native Use was actually applied to the joining owner. Damage requested or prevented, HP loss and unrelated descendant ProgramDamage do not qualify. Native source-loss continuation and any redirected/chained damage are resolved using exact typed use/damage provenance rather than the nearest ancestor or original damage-source seat.
